BEHIND THE NUMBERS

One clear comparison.

Fantasy valuation uses the same fixed prices as the team picker.

Difference = fantasy valuation − contract cap hit. Percentage difference = difference ÷ contract cap hit × 100. Positive means the fantasy valuation is higher; negative means it is lower.

Performance and contract seasons

Fantasy valuations start with the completed 2025–26 regular season and adjust each Monday at noon Helsinki time. The target blends 75% last-season value with 25% current-season full-season pace. Weekly changes are limited to ±5%. Skaters are projected over 82 appearances and goalies over 55; prices wait for five current-season appearances, and goalies with pending GSAx retain their previous price. We compare the current price with the 2026–27 contract. This is a fantasy scoring model, not a prediction or an NHL contract appraisal.

What counts as contract cost?

Annual NHL contract cap hit before any retained-salary discounts. Potential performance bonuses, buried-cap relief, buyouts and total multi-year contract value are excluded.
